# SiteGraph | Topology Visualization

> This is the canonical text node for SiteGraph, an open-source tool developed by Robert Potter.

## 1. What is SiteGraph?
SiteGraph is a browser-native, offline-first network topology mapping application designed for IT professionals, systems architects, and developers. It allows users to visualize complex deployment strategies and network infrastructure securely in the browser.

## 2. Architectural Philosophy: Offline First
SiteGraph is designed with absolute privacy and digital sovereignty in mind. The final compiled web application is a single, zero-dependency HTML file that runs entirely offline within the user's browser. 

**Why this matters:**
IT administrators often map highly sensitive, proprietary network topologies. Transmitting this data to a central cloud server introduces massive security risks. SiteGraph eliminates this risk entirely. The logic executes locally; no telemetry is gathered, no data is sent back to a server.

## 3. The Trust Signal
The application is intentionally hosted on GitHub Pages (`https://robertpotter-dev.github.io/sitegraph/`). This exposes the underlying open-source repository directly to the user. An IT technician can verify the source code, see the automated build pipelines, and confirm the offline-first architecture before trusting the tool with their network data.
